failureRetryProbe.procedure: With a prior legacy save, injected one first town iframe navigation failure after actual title New Game; observed error cover, pressed Escape, then used visible Retry control.
failureRetryProbe.interpretation: Fresh intent survives the failed iframe attempt and is consumed only when the Greenhollow runtime becomes ready. The tested production UI exposed Retry while the error cover was active; Escape did not reach the menu route.

manualSaveRecoveryBoundary.detail: Manual save serializes the live GameState. The town snapshot API checks a validation witness and matching live town, then writes the separate recovery snapshot key; no recovery flags are merged into the manual-save record.

resolvedHarnessFindings.detail: Header now documents serve config cleanUrls:false, which preserves town.html and its relative asset base.
trackPageErrors is attached to the New Game, legacy Continue, and saved-town Playwright pages before navigation.

limitations: Browser evidence does not certify iOS simulator or physical-device behavior.
No production UI path to same-session Continue was observed while the town failure cover was active; reload resets module-local intent, and Retry consumes it after successful readiness.
Manual-save versus recovery-snapshot separation was reviewed in source and was not independently exercised in this browser route.
